name: EdgeGlowPattern
src_typeComment: WHAT the mask/displacement looks like, not just how it's tinted — each pattern computes it itself differently (see UIEdgeGlow.shader), not a re-tint of the same turbulence. Chase is NOT here — it is a separate, orthogonal toggle (see chaseModeEnabled below) that restricts WHATEVER pattern is picked here to a travelling comet+trail, so any pattern's own look can become a travelling comet.
